DP01.01.meaning: UTF-8 patient XML validated on every generation; software/schema identity comment.

DP01.02.meaning: All available mapped mandatory/optional fields and all applicable choices; no invented required values or truncation.

DP01.03.meaning: Provider-roster batch selection includes every patient status and needs no manually assembled cohort.

DP01.05.meaning: Category selection applies to batch and selected-patient exports; demographics remain required.

DP01.06.meaning: ReadMe contains full output paths, group contact, vendor/product/version, export time and physician totals.

DP01.07.meaning: ExportEventLog records sender patient IDs and actual category occurrence counts, including report representation counts.

DP01.08.meaning: Protect all exported patient, ReadMe, event and audit information at rest/in transit; provide a usable decryption path.

DP01.09.meaning: Document generation, compression, encryption and transfer steps.

DP01.10.meaning: Document available support arrangements and their costs without inventing vendor pricing.

DP01.12.meaning: Provide usable access to complete patient audit history after migration, including non-CPP information.

sourceNotes: Uploaded bundle hashes match the pre-existing importer provenance exactly.
The Migration workbook internally labels itself Data Migration 5.1, document version 1.1, June 26 2026; its bundle is 5.2. These are retained as distinct source identities.
The guide defines k as 1000 while several XSD capacities are powers of 1024; export field review must apply the reviewed normative bound without truncating values.
